Pikafish WebAssembly assets in this folder are downloaded during CI from
https://github.com/iFwu/xiangqi-analysis at commit
bf2677c11901b716f48fbd1bbed62d31694ac7af.

`pikafish.js`, `pikafish.wasm`, and `pikafish.data` must stay together.
The engine is GPLv3. Its embedded neural network is subject to the separate
Pikafish Networks license: https://github.com/official-pikafish/Networks#nnue-license.
The web preview is for personal, lawful, noncommercial chess analysis.
